headline: DEWALT and August Robotics' Downward Drilling Robot Named to TIME's Best Inventions of 2026
summary: DEWALT, a Stanley Black & Decker brand renowned for relentless innovation on the jobsite, today announced that DALE, its autonomous downward drilling robot developed in collaboration with global mobile robotics leader August Robotics, has been named to TIME's Best Inventions of 2026 list in the Robotics category. Nominated and evaluated by TIME editors and correspondents around the world, the winning 300 innovations were selected based on originality, efficacy, ambition, and impact.

headline: White Cap and DEWALT® Partner to Support St. Jude Children's Research Hospital for Fourth Year
summary: ATLANTA, October 16, 2026--White Cap, a leading distributor of specialty construction supplies and safety products for professional contractors, and DEWALT, a Stanley Black & Decker (NYSE: SWK) brand and leader in total jobsite solutions, announce a fourth annual partnership supporting the lifesaving mission of St. Jude Children's Research Hospital®: Finding cures. Saving children.®

headline: Wells Fargo Maintains Equal-Weight on Stanley Black & Decker, Lowers Price Target to $90
summary: Wells Fargo  analyst Sam Reid   maintains Stanley Black & Decker (NYSE:SWK) with a Equal-Weight and lowers the price target from $95 to $90.
